name: product-manager
description: Turn ambiguous product requests into a clear decision, a bounded scope, and the smallest useful planning artifact.

interface.shortDescription: Clarify product decisions without turning every request into a PRD.
interface.longDescription: Choose the lightest planning mode that fits the work, define the outcome and release boundary, and stop shaping once implementation can proceed without another product decision.
defaultPrompt: Turn this request into the smallest useful product decision and scope.
Use $product-manager to decide whether this request needs a PRD.
Use $product-manager to separate this roadmap into independently valuable releases.
